name: scenario-to-cloud
description: Operate cloud deployments over the canonical domain: identities and selectors, executable plans reviewed before apply, durable operations with server-side waits, recovery points, credentials, edge and publication. Typed surfaces use the generated Connect clients; exit codes are 0 ok, 1 failed, 2 refused, 3 pending, 124 observer timeout.

omitted.reason: Owner-only reconciliation pass; run by the API on startup and periodically, not an operator command.
Emergency access requires the confirmation string on the API surface with an audited operator identity; no headless alias.
Evidence cells are read through Deployment Manager's readiness surfaces; the CLI exposes the publication standing only.
DataService is not mounted by the API; recovery points use the REST routes under deployment recovery-points.
Rollback admission is evaluated inside deployment rollback --dry-run through the recovery route.
Retention pruning is owned by the API's retention policy, not an operator command.
Release identity is built by the API during execute/plan; bundle build is the operator's input.
Release facts are printed inside deployment plan/get output.
Verification runs as the release.verify plan action; no standalone operator verb.
